title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rintaro Tsumugi attends a low-ranked boys' school whose students are feared by the elite girls' academy next door. He befriends Kaoruko Waguri, a student from that academy who sees past his intimidating looks, and the story follows their gentle romance and the slow easing of prejudice between the two schools (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up kindness, judging people by character rather than appearance, and supporting friends.
